requirement.evidence: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind, except that any city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation that provides:
requirement.note: The exception is voluntary after six months, covers only owners of ten or more units with fair market rent of $400 or less, and requires compensation from general funds. All of this is in the text.
